supraorbital_contour.structural_silhouette: strongly M-shaped with a distinct central depression
supraorbital_contour.lateral_prominence: The ridge extends laterally beyond the outer ocular margins, maintaining a consistent 2D bounding width across the upper face.

macro_zonal_melanin_distribution.regional_intensity_contrast: The muzzle and nasal regions show high pixel intensity (light skin) providing a sharp contrast against the low-intensity (dark skin) periocular and cheek regions.

other_distinctive_markers: A small, circular light-colored spot is visible on the central portion of the supraorbital ridge.
